The '''Sigma series training unit''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was employed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]] during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The droids had eight [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and bare-bones bodies that were covered in belt-treads, and they were used as targets for rookie [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|students]] to practice their [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber technique]] on. The droids lacked any significant degree of intelligence and they were not fitted with [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulators]]. Following an outbreak of a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|deadly disease]] within the academy in [[3645 BBY]], the students [[Kindra]], [[Hartwig]] and [[Mnah Ra'at]] found a Sigma series unit wandering through the academy grounds, and they viewed [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] footage that the droid had recorded on its visual mapping system of [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] Sith students that had became infected with the disease.
